what.a: A SaaS platform for unified organization management: projects, Agile, timesheets, calendar, and teams in one system.

free.q: Is it really free to start?
free.a: Yes. Free sign-up lets you create an organization and use core features without a credit card.

calendar.a: Yes. Jalali and Gregorian calendars, RTL, and Persian/English are natively supported.

security.a: Yes. Multi-tenant architecture keeps each organization's data and settings separate.

roadmap.a: Advanced AI, more integrations and enterprise customization tools are on the roadmap.

landing.ctaSubtitle: Start free today — no card, no commitment.
landing.footerTagline: Unified organization management platform for modern teams.
